label.purpose: Map tools and compact address chip.

shadows.name: chrome
shadows.purpose: Floating search, chips, map tools, location FAB.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Search submit and dialog confirm. Compact search is icon-only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #191919; color: #fff; font: 600 14px Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c2c2c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Place and address query. Compact font-size 16px.
components.css: .ds-input-search { height: 40px; width: 220px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e6e8ec; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #191919; font: 500 14px Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28); }

components.name: Location FAB
components.description: Bottom-right geolocation. Not inside the search row.
components.css: .ds-btn-location { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(25, 25, 25, 0.10), 0 1px 3px rgba(25, 25, 25, 0.06); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-location[data-active="true"] { background: #eef4ff; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #e6e8ec; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #191919; font: 600 13px Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[data-active="true"] { background: #191919; color: #fff; border-color: #191919; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28); }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Map type, overlay, and language rows. Compact: stacked below layers or language toggle.
components.css: .ds-tool-btn { min-width: 88px; height: 40px; border: 0; background: #fff; color: #191919; font: 600 12px Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-btn[data-active="true"] { background: #191919; color: #fff; }

components.name: Place Row
components.css: .ds-place-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-place-item:hover { background: #f4f5f7; } .ds-place-name { font: 700 15px Pretendard, sans-serif; color: #191919; } .ds-place-meta { margin-top: 4px; font: 500 13px Pretendard, sans-serif; color: #5c6370; }

narrative.overview: The map is the canvas. Floating white chrome, ink actions, and a single location-blue accent sit on top without becoming a marketing page. Search, brand chips, tools, language, the location FAB, and the place sheet share one surface language. Compact screens keep zoom and fold type/overlay and language under toggles that open below.
keyCharacteristics: Blue only for location and focus
Marker fade as the only motion

rules.name: The Map First Rule
rules.body: Chrome must remain readable without covering the map in glass, heroes, or page backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is for geolocation, keyboard focus, and pressed 내 근처 / language options. Search and selected chips stay ink.

dos: Keep Kakao-like white bars and black actions.
Keep 8px between compact search and zoom; 16px search input.
Open compact layers and language menus below their toggles.
donts: Do not apply the generator orange/cream palette.
Do not put location or language inside the search row.
Do not add landing-page structure or GSAP.
Do not change search, filter, cluster, or sheet behavior for styling.
